feedback: Remove the unconditional sh:minCount 1 on nltl:exposedStructureMaterial: a universal every-material rule does not independently require a material to exist. Also encode approval authority, approval standard, approved status, and the polar-service-temperature basis per exposed-structure material approval rather than as unrelated ship-level presence/value constraints; the current shape can pass with material and approval facts that are not paired, and only checks presence of PST rather than preserving it as the approval basis.

query_feedback: Preserve the prior requirement to encode approval evidence per exposed-structure material rather than as unrelated ship-level facts. The current shape only checks global ship-level authority, standard, status, and PST presence, so multiple materials can share unpaired approval facts and the PST is not established as the approval basis. Add the canonical qualified approval/material relationship and paths needed to pair each material with its approving authority, approved status, accepted standard, and polarServiceTemperature basis, while keeping the authoritative ship owner and avoiding relocation to benchmarkEntity or a component. The scoped vocabulary supplies no such pairing/basis term, so locate the canonical term/path with the matcher. Retain the absence of unconditional material minCount, and remove the redundant presence-only SPARQL once the qualified constraints are encoded.

feedback_appendix: Use this exact term because approvalEvidence is the canonical class for grouping each exposed-structure material with its qualified approval authority, status, accepted standard, and polarServiceTemperature basis.

Locate the canonical qualified approval-evidence relationship/path and any material-link path with the matcher, then constrain all required nested values using their declared datatypes, unit, controlled alternatives, and ship owner. Do not target benchmarkEntity, relocate properties to a component, invent terms, or use presence-only checks.
